system.roleplaying: You have a darkness in you that you strive to keep suppressed. You can reach out to your dark side to connect with similar forces.
system.minorTwist: What sinister act comes from tapping into your dark side?
system.majorTwist: What havoc does your dark side inflict as you allow it to take control?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Inner Demon
greenAbility.gameText: Tap into your dark psyche to Overcome a problem and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
